item.title: Stop overhyping AI, scientists tell von der Leyen
item.description:
📝 [NurPhoto / Getty Images] A group of scientists has called on Commission President Ursula von der Leyen to retract a statement she made earlier this year when she suggested artificial intelligence would soon reach parity with human intelligence. “Now we expect this to happen already next year. “These are marketing statements driven by profit-motive and ideology rather than empirical evidence and formal proof,” the scientists write in the letter.
🔗 Read more: https://www.euractiv.com/news/stop-overhyping-ai-scientists-tell-von-der-leyen/
